title: Metabolomics Preparation and Analysis
author: Bryan Yoo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzqfp5tn
materials: The samples were then homogenized using a TissueLyser II (Qiagen) for 5 minutes at 25 hertz followed by a 15 minute centrifugation at 14,000 rpm.

The untargeted metabolomics analysis was completed using an ultra-high performance liquid chromatography system (Thermo Dionex Ultimate 3000 UHPLC) coupled to ultra-high resolution quadrupole time of flight (qTOF) mass spectrometer (Bruker Daltonics MaXis HD). Phenomenex Kinetex column (C18 1.7 μ 2.1 mm x 50 mm) was used for chromatographic separation.

steps.title: Animal Treatment
steps.instruction: Deliver AAV-PHP.S:hSYN1-hM3Dq-mRuby2 (1012VGs) systemically to TH-Cre and ChAT-Cre mice. Administer C21 (3mg/kg) daily for 10 consecutive days starting 3-4 weeks after infection.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Transport
steps.instruction: Collect fecal pellets in sterile containers and cecal contents upon sacrifice of the mice. Transport both sample types on dry ice for metabolomics analysis.

steps.title: Sample Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites from weighed samples using an extraction solvent.

substeps.instruction: Prepare extraction solvent consisting of 1:1 methanol to water spiked with an internal standard of 1 µM sulfamethazine.
Add solvent to samples at a 1:10 milligram to microliter ratio.

steps.title: Sample Concentration and Storage
steps.instruction: Concentrate the extracted samples and store them at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 120 µL of the supernatant to a 96 deepwell plate (Eppendorf).
Lyophilize samples using a CentriVap Benchtop Vacuum Concentrator (Labconco).
Store lyophilized plates at −80 °C.

steps.title: Sample Resuspension and Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the lyophilized samples for LCMS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend lyophilized plates in a 1:1 m ℃ ethanol to water solvent spiked with 1 µM of sulfadimethoxine.
Vortex plates for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 15 minutes.
Transfer 120 µL of the supernatant to a 96 well autosampler plate (Eppendorf).
Store plates at 4 °C prior to LCMS analysis.

steps.title: LCMS Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform LCMS analysis using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Set injection volume to 5 µL per sample and flow-rate to 0.500 mL.
Prepare Mobile Phase A: 100% LC-MS grade water spiked with 0.1% formic acid.
Prepare Mobile Phase B: 100% LC-MS grade acetonitrile spiked with 0.1% formic acid.
Collect data using electrospray ionization in positive mode and save as .d file folders.

steps.title: Data Conversion and Archiving
steps.instruction: Convert raw data and archive files.

substeps.instruction: Convert .d data files to mzXML format using Bruker Compass DataAnalysis 4.1 software.
Store .mzXML files, original .d folders, and prep information on the UC San Diego MassIVE data repository (accession MSV000084550).

steps.title: Feature Detection using MZmine
steps.instruction: Perform MS1 level feature detection using MZmine version 2.51 with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Mass Detection: Centroid, Noise Level MS1 1E3, MS2 1E2.
ADAP Chromatogram Builder: Min Group size in # of scans=3, Group Intensity Threshold= 3E3, Min Highest Intensity=1E3, m/z tolerance 0.01 m/z or 10.0 ppm.

Chromatogram Deconvolution: Local Minimum Search > Chromatographic Threshold 0.01%, Minimum in RT range 0.50 min, < Minimum Relative Height 0.01%, Minimum Absolute Height 3E3, Min Ratio of Peak Top/Edge 2, Peak Duration Range 0.05-0.50 min; m/z Calculation Auto, m/z range for MS2 pairing 0.01 Da, and RT Range for MS2 Pairing 0.1 min.
Isotopic Peaks Grouper: m/z Tolerance 0.01 m/z or 10.0 ppm, Retention Time Tolerance 0.3 min, Maximum Charge 4, Representative Ion Most Intense.
Join Aligner: m/z Tolerance 0.01 m/z or 10.0 ppm, Weight for m/z 75, Retention Time Tolerance 0.3 min, Weight for RT 25.
Gap-Filling Peak Finder: Intensity Tolerance 20%, m/z Tolerance 0.005 m/z or 10.0 ppm, Retention Time Tolerance 0.2 min.
Save resulting feature table as .csv and .mgf files.

steps.title: Molecular Networking via GNPS
steps.instruction: Perform feature-based molecular networking using the GNPS portal with the .mgf and .csv outputs from MZmine v2.51.

substeps.instruction: Set parameters: Precursor Ion Mass 0.02 Da, Fragment Ion Mass Tolerance 0.02 Da, Min Pairs Cos 0.7, Minimum Matched Fragments 6, Maximum Shift Between Precursors 500 Da, Network TopK 10, Maximum Connected Component Size (Beta) 100.
Apply row sum normalization to files.
Use default parameters for all other settings.

steps.title: Visualization and Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform final data analysis and visualization using QIIME 2 v.2019.10, MetaboAnalyst, and Cytoscape v3.7.2.
